caption: Pienza and Val d'Orcia, Pienza
composition: Renaissance piazza terrace over Val d'Orcia hills · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands on the stone piazza terrace at the edge of Pienza, looking out over the Val d'Orcia. The great travertine facade of the palazzo fills the left of the frame, the small piazza and its church tower sit at the center, and the misty hills roll away to the right in layer upon layer. The modelled 23 September 2026, 07:38 morning light is soft and golden on the stone, with thin haze settling in the far valleys below.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Pienza overlooking Val d'Orcia under clear dawn light
